> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR

> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-settings/README.md`, `packages/services/service-settings/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os serve (command, 47 pages)`
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **41** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8f05e61bb33a17a196785d7df2109cdd81ee1e97` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3a61034b5436427f3ada2bc18a07cfa112f14cba` — the merge of head `26eb6119c48ab35d966e4adfe199644779026e92` into base `8f05e61bb33a17a196785d7df2109cdd81ee1e97`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3a61034b5436427f3ada2bc18a07cfa112f14cba && git checkout 3a61034b5436427f3ada2bc18a07cfa112f14cba
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8f05e61bb33a17a196785d7df2109cdd81ee1e97 26eb6119c48ab35d966e4adfe199644779026e92 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8f05e61bb33a17a196785d7df2109cdd81ee1e97 && git merge --no-ff 26eb6119c48ab35d966e4adfe199644779026e92

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8f05e61bb33a17a196785d7df2109cdd81ee1e97
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8f05e61bb33a17a196785d7df2109cdd81ee1e97` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 两份数据密钥文件（家目录共享的那份和项目自己的那份）钥匙不同时，启动从「只试开最新一条密文」改成「试开最新一页（最多十条）」，取打开更多条的那把；两把各开一部分时，按多数用、打一条点名两个文件和条数的 error。
- **为什么改：** 原来只看一条：最新一条坏了，生产就整体拒启；数据库里两把钥匙混着封的密文，启动却一声不吭。
- **风险与回滚：** 两份文件钥匙相同或只有一份时行为不变；一页里两把都打不开仍按原样生产拒启。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看：** `local-crypto-provider.ts` 的 `chooseKeyFileByTrialOpen` 与新的 `scoreKeyOverPage`，再看测试里 `#30091` 那组。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/local-crypto-provider.test.ts`。
- **需要您做的：** 无，席位经合并队列落地（非受管面，390 行）。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT。开发留的问题「两把钥匙混用时生产是否也拒启」，席位按卡面裁 A（照常启动、打 error）：卡写的是「报为点名两条路径的混合密钥启动错误」，是报错不是拒启；拒启是收窄，还会让运维没有一个在跑的服务去重新保存少数那部分密文。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:server#2 · head `26eb6119c48ab35d966e4adfe199644779026e92`

- **形态:** draft, author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay `pr_create`), no assignee, no review request; 11 files, +306 −84; `check-governed-merges --pr 30232`: NOT governed (0 of 11 paths), 390 lines ≤ 3000. Dev write tally: 2 relay writes, `mcp_calls` 5 reads, 0 MCP writes.
- **前提实测:** on `origin/main`, `storedSecretReaderOverEngine` already fetched `TRIAL_SAMPLE_PAGE` (10) rows and returned the first known-marker one, and `chooseKeyFileByTrialOpen` judged that one row (claim 6647291404 `Premise: holds`). The diff returns the known-marker page and scores both keys over it; `neither = judged − c − l` is sound because two distinct AES-GCM keys cannot both open one row.
- **逻辑核对 (seat read):** both 0 ⇒ production `DataKeyOpensNothingError(…, judged)`, else canonical + error; one side 0 ⇒ `opens` warn naming the measured count; both > 0 ⇒ `mixed` error naming both paths, both counts and the fix, in every posture. Tie-break `legacyWins` takes the legacy file only when it opens strictly more, or the same count with a strictly newer first row; otherwise canonical keeps it. Missing-table read still answers empty (`no-stored-secret`), any other failed read still `not-judged`.
- **门禁 check-runs:** 50 runs on the head, 38 `success`, 12 `skipped`, 0 failing. Dev: `dispatch-gates` 95/95 exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED / 0 UNRUN; service-settings 1159/1159; 3 ablations (one-row slice 8 red, refusal line 4 red, mixed-as-quiet 5 red), each restored to HEAD.
- **契约复审:** not owed. `Clause-②: no` verified: `@objectstack/service-settings@18.3.0` (npm latest; tag source) contains none of `chooseKeyFileByTrialOpen` / `StoredSecretReader` / `DataKeyOpensNothingError` (0 hits), so the changed shapes (#30042 via #30087) first ship in this release. No `packages/spec`, no governed rule text, no narrowing declaration ⇒ CI + seat self-read.
- **散文面逐句核 (`TIER_DEFAULT`):** changeset sentences "trial-opens each of the newest stored `sys_secret` rows (up to ten) … on a tie the one that opens the newest", "a row that opens under neither key … no longer decides the boot", "only a page where no row opens under either key keeps the production refusal" and the Supersedes paragraph's quoted refusal text match the diff. `backup-restore.mdx` paragraph: canonical path (`OS_HOME`, else `~/.objectstack`), legacy only when it alone holds a key, "uses the file whose key opens more", split ⇒ error naming both files, neither ⇒ production refuses — each matches the code. README file-tier text and the `serve.ts` catch comment (#30087 nits) checked against the code they describe.
- **裁决 (open question):** A — keep the boot on the majority key with the error notice. Card text "report … as a mixed-key boot error that names both paths" is satisfied by an `error` notice; B (refuse) is a narrowing the card did not ask for. Not escalated.
- **接受的偏差:** two cli test stubs changed one line each (one-row page after the reader type change, assertions unchanged); `settings-service-plugin.ts` / `index.ts` touched for the same type and a comment; the operator paragraph lives in `content/docs/deployment/backup-restore.mdx` (the page that already names the dev key), one paragraph only.
- **范围外去向:** none. `Skills-docs:` not owed (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
- **落地条款:** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, changeset `patch` for `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/service-settings`. Ordinary queue landing by this seat: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` on this head.
